newsitem.title: USA: Nortel says in deal with Cox.
newsitem.headline: Nortel says in deal with Cox.

text.p: Northern Telecom Ltd said on Wednesday it had entered into a deal with Cox Communications Inc to build the switching and access portions of Cox's multiservice network, designed to deliver voice and data transmission services in select markets nationwide.
The deal was worth about $65 million, the company said.
As part of the pact, Cox will deploy Nortel's DMS-500 Local/Long Distance switching systems in its major markets across the country.
